provenance.reference: Controlled black-box observation with evidence/e2e/M2-022/tools/capture_punctuation_clipboard.py on the owner-approved Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 host: external Barrier server barriers 2.4.0-release and client barrierc 2.4.0-release, protocol 1.6, each on its own virtual X display, through a byte-logging loopback relay. Input was synthetic (xdotool on the server display); clipboard text was set with xclip to fixed probe strings on each display. TLS disabled for this observation only. Session: handshake, server clipboard sent on enter, the eleven US punctuation keys plain and shifted, a client copy, the client clipboard sent on leave, a second enter and leave.
